result.summary: The page is largely intact and functional, but there are minor edge-clipping issues: the third restaurant title in the "Fastest near you" carousel and the rating text in the "Popular right now" section are cut off at the right screen edge.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel, the third restaurant card's title, "Trattoria Piccol", is clipped by the right screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel row can scroll fully so the last item and its complete title are reachable, and add right-edge padding or a fade so partial items look intentional.

issues.description: In the "Popular right now" section, the restaurant rating text is positioned flush against the right screen edge, with the closing parenthesis and count partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding to the row so the rating and review count are fully visible and not truncated at the edge.
